//: The import rules between the parts of the repository (REFACTOR-PLAN.md section 2.2, PKG-0). scripts/check/boundaries.mjs (npm run check:boundaries) reads every static import, re-export and literal dynamic import() in the tracked .js/.mjs/.cjs files and fails on an edge the importing unit does not allow. A file belongs to the first unit whose paths hold it, so the narrower units come first. `allow` lists the units a unit may import (itself always; '*' any, '!name' not that one); `node` says whether node:* built-ins are allowed; npm packages (bare names) and imports of files no unit holds (data, root files) are not checked. Departures from the plan's table, by decision: core and api may import the generated registry slices (registries-browser, pure data; api for the contribution machine decide.js reads); map may import frontend (src/) until F2/F4 move the rest of the map app out of src/. The served pages (site/, site/apps/ as its own unit, and the retired apps' kill-switch worker render/sw.js) are not bundled: they may import only site/ files and the units packages/served.json serves ('@served'), and an import of a served path (site/assets/ui/...) resolves to the package file the browser is given; site/ may not import an app under site/apps/ (added 11 Nov 2026, architecture rule R1, after the site move had left site/ in no unit). `baseline` lists known violating edges ('from -> to' file paths); it may only shrink. Its one entry is the PRONI record page's server render, which imports the PRONI app's renderer (found when site/ joined the rules; the renderer belongs in packages/ui). `unowned` lists the scripts deliberately in no unit, with reasons.

unowned.//: Tracked scripts that belong to no unit, each with its reason (architecture rule R1; check C2 in npm run check:architecture fails on a script in no unit and not listed here, and on an entry here that matches nothing). A key ending in / covers a folder.
unowned.eslint.config.mjs: the linter's own configuration, read only by eslint
unowned.config/playwright.config.cjs: the browser-test runner's configuration, read only by Playwright
unowned.data/elections-source/js/: the election viewer's source copy (classic scripts, no imports); check:viewer-parity holds site/app/election-viewer-package/ to it
unowned.data/review-inputs/: one-off review tools kept with the review inputs they read; never imported or served
unowned.docs/: example and handoff scripts quoted by documents; never imported, served or run by the build
